request: In the Consumable Stock sheet (Batch No, Description, Expiry Date, Qty On Hand, Remark) write Expired in Remark for every batch whose Expiry Date is before today and Expiring soon for the ones that expire in the next 30 days, and clear the Remark on the others. A batch with no Expiry Date gets no remark. Tell me how many are expired.

In the WPS Register (WPS No, Process, Thickness Min, Thickness Max, Remark) write Range? in Remark for every WPS where Thickness Min or Thickness Max is blank or not a number, or where the minimum is bigger than the maximum, and clear the Remark on the others. Tell me how many I marked.

In the Calibration Tracker (Instrument ID, Type, Last Calibrated, Next Calibration Due) highlight the Instrument ID cell red when Next Calibration Due is blank, and yellow when it is a date earlier than Last Calibrated (someone mixed the two up). Clear old highlights first so it can be run again, and tell me how many cells I coloured.

In the Job Tracker (Job ID, Customer, Start Date, Due Date, Status) write Bad dates in a Flag column when the Due Date is before the Start Date, and No due date when a job that is not Closed has no Due Date. Clear the Flag on all the other jobs, add the Flag heading if it is missing, and tell me how many jobs I flagged.

In the BOM sheet (Part No, Description, Required Qty, Unit, Remark) write Unit? in Remark for every row whose Unit is blank or is not one of NOS, KG, MTR or SET (people type them in any case and with stray spaces), and clear the Remark on the others. Tell me how many rows need a unit fixed.

From the Consumable Issue log (Issue No, Batch No, Qty Issued, Job ID) build a Job Issue Summary sheet with one row per Job ID: the number of issues and the total Qty Issued, the biggest total first. Ignore rows with no Job ID, and leave out of the total any Qty Issued that is not a number. The sheet is rebuilt every run.

From the PQR List (PQR No, Process, Test Date, Result) write a PQR Summary sheet with each process, how many PQRs it has and how many of them have the Result Fail, processes A to Z, and a last row Total with the two sums. Ignore rows with no process. The sheet is rebuilt every run.

From the BOM sheet (Part No, Description, Required Qty, Unit) make a Unit Totals sheet with the total Required Qty for each Unit, units A to Z. KG and kg are the same unit. Rows with no unit or with a Required Qty that is not a number are left out; tell me how many rows I left out.

From the Job Tracker (Job ID, Customer, Due Date, Status) make a Customer Load sheet with, for each customer, how many jobs are not Closed and how many of those are past their Due Date, the customer with the most open jobs first. A customer whose jobs are all Closed does not appear. The sheet is rebuilt every run.

Check the WPS Register (WPS No, Process, Filler Class) against the Consumable Stock sheet (Batch No, Filler Class, Qty On Hand). In the WPS Register write No stock in a Stock Remark column for every WPS whose Filler Class has no batch with Qty On Hand above zero, and clear it on the others. Add the heading if it's missing. Filler classes are typed with stray spaces and in mixed case. Tell me how many WPS have no stock.

Compare the BOM (Part No, Description, Heat No) with the Material Certs sheet (Heat No, MTC No, Grade). In the BOM fill an MTC No column with the certificate number of each line's heat, and write Missing there when the heat has no certificate. A BOM line with no Heat No keeps an empty MTC No. Add the heading if it isn't there. Heat numbers can differ in case and stray spaces. Tell me how many are Missing.

In the WPS Register (WPS No, Process, PQR Ref) the Process cells are typed all sorts of ways: 'smaw', ' SMAW', 'Gtaw '. Make every Process trimmed and upper case, and empty any PQR Ref cell that holds only spaces. Change nothing else, and tell me how many cells I changed.

In the Calibration Tracker (Instrument ID, Type, Location, Status) the Status cells are typed many ways. Make every status that reads ok, in cal or calibrated (any case, stray spaces) read exactly Calibrated, and every one that reads oos or out of service read exactly Out of Service. Leave any other status and blank cells alone, and tell me how many cells I changed.

For every row of the Consumable Stock sheet (Batch No, Description, Cert File, Cert Status) check whether the file named in Cert File is in the Batch Certs folder (a folder path I give the macro), and write Found or Missing in Cert Status; a row with no Cert File gets No file name. Do not change, copy or delete any file. Tell me how many are Missing.

The file heat.txt in the Certs folder (a folder path I give the macro) holds one heat number. Find that Heat No on the Material Certs sheet (Heat No, MTC No, Supplier, Remark) and write Verified in its Remark. Tell me the row, or 0 when that heat is not on the sheet. If the file is not there, change nothing and say so. Never change the file.

A consumables stock tool, started with one macro. (1) In the Consumable Stock sheet (Batch No, Filler Class, Qty On Hand, Reorder Level, Expiry Date, Remark) write Expired in Remark where the Expiry Date is before today, otherwise Reorder where Qty On Hand is at or below Reorder Level, and clear Remark on the others. (2) On a Reorder List sheet list the Reorder batches with the same headings, the lowest Qty On Hand first. (3) On a Class Summary sheet write each Filler Class with its total Qty On Hand, not counting expired batches, and its number of expired batches, classes A to Z. (4) Tell me how many batches are expired. The output sheets are rebuilt every run.

A job material tool, started with one macro. (1) In the BOM sheet (Job ID, Part No, Required Qty, Issued Qty, Remark) write Short in Remark where Issued Qty is less than Required Qty, Check where either quantity is not a number, and clear Remark on the others. (2) On a Job Shortage sheet write each Job ID that has Short lines with its number of Short lines, the most first. (3) In the Job Tracker (Job ID, Customer, Status, Material Flag) write Waiting material in Material Flag for every job that is not Closed and has at least one Short line, and clear it on the others. (4) Tell me how many jobs are waiting. The Job Shortage sheet is rebuilt every run.

A calibration follow-up tool, started with one macro. (1) In the Calibration Tracker (Instrument ID, Type, Location, Next Calibration Due) highlight the whole row red when the instrument is overdue and yellow when it is due in the next 30 days, clearing old highlights first. (2) On a Due List sheet list the overdue and due-soon instruments with the same headings, the earliest due date first. (3) On a Location Summary sheet write each Location with how many of its instruments are overdue and how many are due soon, locations A to Z. (4) Tell me how many are overdue. Instruments with no due date are left alone. The output sheets are rebuilt every run.

A material certificate tool, started with one macro. (1) In the Material Certs sheet (Heat No, MTC No, Supplier, Grade, Remark) make every Heat No trimmed and upper case. (2) Write Check in Remark for every row with no MTC No or no Grade, and clear Remark on the others. (3) On a Grade Summary sheet write each Grade with its number of certificates, grades A to Z; rows with no grade are counted under No grade. (4) On a Chase List sheet write once each Supplier that has at least one Check row, A to Z. (5) Tell me how many rows are Check. The output sheets are rebuilt every run.

A PQR follow-up tool, started with one macro. (1) In the WPS Register (WPS No, Process, PQR Ref, Remark) write PQR failed in Remark for every WPS whose PQR Ref is a PQR with the Result Fail in the PQR List (PQR No, Process, Test Date, Result), PQR missing when the PQR Ref is blank or not in the list, and clear Remark on the others. (2) On a Problem WPS sheet list the WPS that have a remark, with the same headings, WPS No A to Z. (3) On a Process Summary sheet write each process in the register with its number of WPS and how many of them have a remark, processes A to Z. (4) Tell me how many WPS have a remark. PQR numbers differ in case and stray spaces. The output sheets are rebuilt every run.
